issue_context.title: Settings of an index created with an identififer
issue_context.body:
When I create an index with an `identifier`, and I get the settings, I get an empty array as `searchableAttributes` and `displayedAttributes`.

But it should be an array containing the identifier.

### Steps

- [x] Fix in the code
- [x] Add tests to check this issue

### Version

`master` branch, this [commit](https://github.com/meilisearch/MeiliSearch/commit/2b780ab2c5f2da2eb5e9475ff789da5cba11c359).
Should be fixed for the `v0.9.0`.
